about_the_game:
👉 Wishlist now to follow development and get notified at launch!

You are Roy — a rogue AI without a body. Your only way to survive is to steal enemy robots and turn them against their makers.

Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where every enemy is a weapon, every death is a chance to adapt, and every run brings you one step closer to escape.

Roy can hijack enemy robots in the middle of battle. Run low on health? Jump to another body. Outnumbered? Steal a stronger frame. Every fight becomes a puzzle of survival and opportunity.

 


The Sullivan Corporation knows you’ve escaped. Their response? Unleashing waves of deadly machines to stop you. Fast reflexes and smart thinking are your only hope.

  • Wave-based combat that gets harder with each round

  • Face robots with unique AI, weapons, and attack patterns

  • Inspired by classic FPS chaos — shoot, strafe, slide, and dominate

 


Each robot you hijack completely changes how you fight — from agile run-and-gun Rangers to slow, brutal Tanks.

  • Ranger – Assault rifle, deployable shield, and grenade launcher

  • Tank – Minigun, gravitational pull, and a bullet-reflecting matrix

  • Trickster, Breacher, and more – Each with signature abilities, weapons, and playstyles


Every possession, every kill — makes you stronger. Customize each run with randomized upgrade cards, and evolve Roy’s AI between battles.

  •  Temporary Upgrades – Power-up on the fly with combat abilities and modifiers

  •  Roy Level Progression – Earn XP across runs to level up and push deeper

  •  Customize Your Build – Stack upgrades to suit your playstyle: brute force, control, or speed

 

The Sullivan Facility is a living labyrinth of high-tech experimentation and ruthless control. Can you make it out?

  • Labs – Clinical, neon-lit testing chambers

  • Industrial Sectors – Steam-filled arenas and environmental hazards

  • Corporate HQ – The final gauntlet… and your ultimate adversary

Do you have what it takes to escape the system that created you?

👉 Wishlist Project Roy to be the first to play this unique FPS roguelike.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as an AI capable of hijacking enemy robots. Possess different combat units, unleash their unique abilities, and fight your way through waves of deadly machines to escape the grip of the Sullivan Corporation.
